title: The Lost Cat
text:
Tom has a small cat. Its name is Milo. One day, Milo does not come home. Tom looks for him in the park.

Tom finds Milo under a big tree. Milo is hungry and tired. Tom takes him home and gives him some milk. Tom is very happy.

questions.text: What is the name of Tom's cat?
How does Tom probably feel about Milo?
What is probably true about Milo?
options: He usually comes home on time

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people walk and play
wanting food because you have not eaten for some time
a tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves
feeling good because something nice has happened

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene un gato pequeño. Se llama Milo. Un día, Milo no vuelve a casa. Tom lo busca en el parque.
Tom encuentra a Milo debajo de un árbol grande. Milo tiene hambre y está cansado. Tom lo lleva a casa y le da un poco de leche. Tom está muy feliz.
